preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 500,000, inclusive.
The size of the permutation N is between 1 and 100,000, inclusive.
Each element of the permutation A is an integer between 1 and N, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: All elements of A are distinct
preconditions.description: The permutation A consists of all integers from 1 to N exactly once.

postconditions.expression: output is a permutation of size N
postconditions.description: The output is a permutation of the same size as the input, containing integers from 1 to N.
The output permutation is the lexicographically smallest permutation that can be achieved by applying any number of left shifts and at most two swaps.
